items.headline: Jackson out for Sunday night, real chance to return vs. Browns
items.summary: Jackson (ankle) is inactive against Atlanta, and ESPN reports he has a "real chance" to play next week at Cleveland. Tyler Huntley starts tonight.

items.headline: Huntley starts at quarterback for Baltimore
items.summary: Huntley takes the first-team snaps with Jackson out, which lowers the ceiling for Baltimore's passing game and removes Jackson's rushing yards.

items.headline: Johnston and Thompson inactive vs. Broncos
items.summary: Johnston (chest) and Brenen Thompson are inactive, while Ladd McConkey is active, so Chargers targets concentrate on McConkey, the tight ends and the backs.

items.headline: Harrison traded to Houston, out for Arizona tonight
items.summary: The Texans completed a trade for Harrison. He is listed out for Arizona's game against Detroit, so Arizona has one fewer receiver.

items.headline: Harrison joins Houston for next week
items.summary: Houston acquired Harrison from Arizona. His snap count and target share with the Texans are unknown.

items.headline: Charbonnet stays out vs. 49ers
items.summary: Charbonnet (knee) will not be activated from reserve before Seattle's game with San Francisco. George Holani is active.

items.headline: Palmer out for Monday night
items.summary: Palmer (shoulder) is ruled out against the Rams. Skyler Bell is expected to make his NFL regular-season debut.

items.headline: Eagles back Shipley hurt in London
items.summary: Shipley (foot) left the loss to Jacksonville. Philadelphia was already without Saquon Barkley, so the backfield looks depleted heading into next week.

items.headline: Montgomery ruled out of Texans win with groin injury
items.summary: Montgomery left the win over Tennessee with a groin injury. Next week's status is unknown, so Houston's backfield share is uncertain.

items.headline: Henderson leaves Patriots win with ankle injury
items.summary: Henderson was ruled out for the rest of the Raiders game. Rhamondre Stevenson is the other main back, so New England's workload could shift next week.

items.headline: Concepcion exits Browns loss with head injury
items.summary: Concepcion left the game at the Jets after a hit to the head and was ruled out. A concussion would put next week in doubt.

items.headline: Hockenson suffers a concussion vs. Saints
items.summary: Hockenson left Minnesota's win with a concussion, which puts his availability next week in question. Ben Yurosek was active today.

items.headline: McConkey active despite foot injury
items.summary: He is active against Denver after being questionable, but he may be below full speed with a foot injury he aggravated earlier this season.

items.headline: Kittle plays through illness
items.summary: The 49ers announced Kittle has an illness but will play against Seattle. A reduced snap count is possible.

items.headline: Flowers slated to play Sunday night
items.summary: ESPN reports Flowers (foot) is expected to play in Atlanta, but ESPN's inactives story still lists him as questionable.

items.headline: Moore questionable for Monday night
items.summary: Moore (shoulder) is questionable after practicing in a noncontact jersey, and Joshua Palmer is out, so Buffalo's receiver group is thin against the Rams.

items.headline: Barkley missed London game with hamstring injury
items.summary: Barkley was inactive against Jacksonville. His availability for next week is unknown, and Dameon Pierce led the backfield with 11 carries for 14 yards.

items.headline: Jones returned after knee scare
items.summary: Jones returned to the game in New Orleans after a knee issue, so he should keep his normal role if he practices this week.

items.headline: Sadiq enters concussion protocol after Jets win
items.summary: Sadiq did not return to the win over Cleveland because of a concussion, which makes next week uncertain.

items.headline: Dowdle inactive, Warren dominates
items.summary: Dowdle (toe) was inactive and Jaylen Warren had 188 yards from scrimmage and two touchdowns in the win. Warren is the clear lead back if Dowdle misses more time.

items.headline: Two Steelers receivers hurt vs. Colts
items.summary: Skowronek (leg) and Roman Wilson (finger) were ruled out for the rest of the game, which could thin Pittsburgh's receiver group.

items.headline: Williams inactive, Bagent starts in loss
items.summary: Williams (hamstring) was inactive in Green Bay and Tyson Bagent started. ESPN notes Williams may be ready for next week against Atlanta.

items.headline: Love has no injury designation vs. Lions
items.summary: Arizona's beat reporter says Love (ankle) carries no designation into the game, so he should keep his normal workload.

items.headline: Charles out for 49ers game
items.summary: Charles (knee) is ruled out. Montorie Foster Jr. is also inactive, which thins Seattle's receiver depth.

items.headline: Moore leaves Packers win with ankle injury
items.summary: Moore left the 31-7 win over Chicago. Christian Watson had 143 yards and two touchdowns, so his role looks secure.

items.headline: Monangai inactive vs. Packers
items.summary: Monangai (toe) was inactive in Chicago's loss, so D'Andre Swift handled the lead role. His availability next week is unknown.
